originalTitle: Ukraine hit by strikes after Russia agrees to new peace talks
summary: The three waves of Russian missiles were launched at hours after Russia said it was "ready in principle" to resume peace talks with the US and Ukraine.
content:
Kyiv has been hit by another round of missile strikes hours after Russia agreed to resume peace talks on Wednesday.

Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky said the three waves of missiles were launched by "Russian humanitarians".

This comes after US envoy Steve Witkoff called Russia's President Vladimir Putin a "humanitarian" following a meeting in St Petersburg on Wednesday.

Russia said it was "ready in principle" to resume peace talks with the US and Ukraine.

The BBC's Dan Johnson reports from the scene of a destroyed retail park.
chineseTitle: 俄罗斯同意新的和平谈判后乌克兰遭受袭击
chineseSummary: 俄罗斯发射三波导弹是在俄罗斯表示“原则上准备好”恢复与美国和乌克兰的和谈几小时后发射的。
chineseContent:
在俄罗斯周三同意恢复和谈几小时后，基辅又遭到了另一轮导弹袭击。

乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，这三波导弹是由“俄罗斯人道主义者”发射的。

此前，美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫周三在圣彼得堡举行会议后称俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京是“人道主义者”。

俄罗斯表示“原则上准备好”恢复与美国和乌克兰的和谈。

BBC 的丹·约翰逊在一个被毁坏的零售公园现场进行报道。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
